title: Framework SQL built from input (sqlalchemy) — review required
description: A sqlalchemy data call assembles SQL from parts: texts*([^)]*(?:+|f['"]). Framework helpers do not sanitize interpolated values. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms every part is trusted or parameterizes it.
remediation: Use the framework's binding (bindparams()); never interpolate values.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled query matches, including trusted ones.
